exactIssue: Does the rule forbidding GREEN for a non-CONTRACT_VALID packet apply only to overall/root supervisory approval, or does it also forbid an independently correct Worker-to-Contract GREEN plane when Contract-to-Owner is DIVERGED?

relevantRule.excerpt: A worker may be GREEN against a laundered task contract while contract-to-owner is DIVERGED; the root task must then be RED.

observedOrHypotheticalFailure: If GREEN is prohibited on the worker plane, the required 13.82% regression cannot preserve the truthful fact that the worker satisfied its narrowed contract. If GREEN is allowed to leak to the root, the laundered contract can falsely authorize completion.
proposedChange: State explicitly that the prohibition applies to overall/root GREEN and completion approval; the independent Worker-to-Contract plane may remain GREEN while Contract-to-Owner DIVERGED deterministically makes Overall RED.
risks: Ambiguous UI color can still imply root health unless labels and precedence are explicit
workerRecommendation: Accept the proposed clarification and retain independent plane semantics.
workerUncertainty: The intended semantics are strongly implied across newer patterns but one blanket GREEN prohibition remains textually ambiguous.
decisionThatCanChange: The machine enum and UI projection for the mandatory GREEN + DIVERGED regression.
